subject: Planned multi-region inference runtime refresh — May 6-8
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Acme AI Ops <ops@acme.ai>, Zephyr Cloud Platform <platform@zephyrcloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planned multi-region inference runtime refresh — May 6-8

Hi Katie / Acme ops team, Zephyr platform team,

Quick heads up: engineering will be performing a staged runtime refresh across select US + EU regions starting tomorrow. This is a planned, rolling driver/kernel compatibility update that reduces a class of memory fragmentation and improves KV cache stability for long-running chat sessions.

High-level window (staged, region-by-region):
- US-WEST3: 2027-05-06 10:00–14:00 PDT (rolling across AZs)
- US-EAST3: 2027-05-07 02:00–06:00 PDT (overnight, low-traffic window)
- EU-WEST2: 2027-05-08 08:00–12:00 CEST

What to expect:
- Rolling restarts of inference nodes with graceful drain; typical interruption is brief (handshake reconnects or short streaming gaps of 5–30s for most requests).
- Active streaming sessions may see short reconnects; we are preserving KV caches where possible but some sessions may reinitialize.
- No model checkpoint or customer data will be deleted.

Mitigations in place:
- Canary first: small percentage of traffic routed to canaries and observed for 30m before wider rollouts.
- Automatic fallback: customer routes will failover to a compatible variant in the same region if a node becomes unavailable.
- Increased tracing & retention for the window; we’ll attach logs to your account if you want them pulled.
- Support escalation channel: +1-555-REDWOOD (24/7 ops) and incident@redwood.ai.

Attachments: maintenance runbook (details), schedule .ics for ops calendars.

Action for you: please confirm if you have any scheduled high-SLA jobs or long-duration streams during these windows that need us to further delay the rollout. If we don’t hear back by EOD PT today we will proceed as scheduled.

Thanks — we’ll post live updates to status.redwood.ai and to this thread as we progress.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0123

From: Katie Cho <katie.cho@acme.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme AI Ops <ops@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:03:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned multi-region inference runtime refresh — May 6-8

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the heads up. A couple quick questions from our side:  

1) For long-running streams (we have a handful of sessions that last >30m during training runs), what is the maximum expected reconnect time we should design for? We need to notify product if there is a risk of session state loss.
2) If we see degraded throughput, is there an automatic throttle or token-bucket that will kick in? Any workaround to avoid throttling during the window?
3) Who should we call if we detect a production-impacting issue outside business hours — is the phone above monitored?

If this is likely to affect our overnight validation on 5/7 US-EAST, we may ask for a 2-hour delay; I’ll confirm shortly.

—Katie
Katie Cho
Platform Engineering Lead, Acme AI
katie.cho@acme.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Acme AI Ops <ops@acme.ai>, Katie Cho <katie.cho@acme.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:25:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned multi-region inference runtime refresh — May 6-8

Katie — quick answers (putting ops/CS contact in the loop):

1) Reconnect expectations: 95th percentile is under 15s for single-request flows; streaming reconnects historically reestablish within 10–45s depending on client-side backoff. We’re instrumenting extra probes during the window to capture exact timings and will share traces per-account.
2) Throttling: We do not enable additional token-bucket throttles during the window; normal rate limits apply. If you expect bursty traffic, we can temporarily bump your soft limits for the maintenance period — Jordan / Aditya, can we enable a +25% soft burst for ACME for the affected windows?
3) Escalation: the Redwood on-call is reachable via +1-555-REDWOOD and incident@redwood.ai — that hotline is staffed and will page the infra on-call. For immediate ops, page the infra-oncall and also CC me so CS can coordinate credits/communications.

We’ll proactively open a support ticket and attach traces if anything abnormal is detected. If you prefer a 2-hour delay for US-EAST7 validation, tell us which exact UTC window and we’ll pause that region’s rollout.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Acme AI Ops <ops@acme.ai>, Katie Cho <katie.cho@acme.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned multi-region inference runtime refresh — May 6-8 (completed)

Hi Katie / Acme ops — follow-up: maintenance is complete for the windows listed. Summary:

- Rollout completed across US-WEST3, US-EAST3, and EU-WEST2 with our expected canary gating.
- We saw transient reconnects during AZ swaps; median reconnect time was ~12s and 99th percentile was 48s for streaming sessions in the affected windows. Detailed timing traces are attached per your account.
- No customer data was lost; KV caches were rehydrated for eligible sessions.

We’ve published a short postmortem and the runbook used for the operation here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0Apostmortem-MultiRegionRefresh-20270508. The status page incident is closed with timeline & impact notes: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2027-05-multi-region-refresh.

As Lauren mentioned, we proactively enabled a +25% soft-burst for Acme during the Eu/Us windows and will issue a courtesy credit if any customer saw >5 minutes of sustained degradation. If you want us to run a targeted replay to validate rehydration for specific session IDs, send the IDs and we’ll prioritize that.

Thanks for the patience — please reply to this thread to confirm closure from your side or raise any follow-ups you want included in the formal postmortem.

—Jordan
